instruction.text: Convert this sentence from the active voice to the passive voice.

hint.text: Make sure to keep all the same information from the original sentence when constructing the new one. Capital letters and full stops should also help you work it out.

atoms.a: E.B. White wrote the novel Charlotte’s Web.

instruction.text: Fill in the gap to convert the sentence from the active voice to the passive voice.

hint.text: Remember to use the same verb as the original sentence, just add the correct form of the verb to be.

atoms.a: Maria takes the best photos of us.
atoms.b: The best photos of us ((are_taken)) by Maria.

atoms.a: We bought the furniture at a local shop.
atoms.b: The furniture ((was_bought)) by us at a local shop.
